title: Sunday · the chorus
logline: The message boards as landscape: the beach, and along the whole back of the top tier, thirty stick figures watching. Wood on the drift log with his back to them, arguing.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach. Along the back of the tier, at the tideline, thirty stick figures in a row, holding tiny signs, all facing the drift log. On the log, from behind: Wood, and the dog.

characters.pose: thirty, in a row at the back, with signs

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a beach with a row of thirty crude stick figures holding tiny signs standing at the tideline all facing a bleached drift log where a man and a dog sit with their backs to them, no words
image.notes: Signs unreadable. Thirty figures exactly; the count matters.

panels.name: Thirty

panels.composition: Tier 2: Wood from behind, one hand up, mid-argument with the horizon. The dog looking back at the chorus.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a man seen from behind on a log with one hand raised mid-argument toward the sea, a dog beside him looking back over its shoulder, no words

panels.name: Back

panels.composition: Tier 3: the chorus from behind, all thirty, signs up, facing the log and the man and the sea. Two of them turning to look at the dog.

characters.pose: from behind, two turning to the dog

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, thirty crude stick figures seen from behind holding signs and facing a distant man on a log by the sea, two of them turned toward a small dog, no words

panels.name: Signs

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Thirty. Two of them look at the dog. The seed of the parody, as a landscape.
